    window.__show742ModuleFailure = function () {
      if (document.body.dataset.viewerStarted === "true" || document.body.dataset.viewerTerminal === "true") return;
      const failure = document.querySelector("#error");
      document.body.classList.add("viewer-terminal-error");
      document.body.dataset.viewerTerminal = "true";
      document.body.dataset.machineSource = "module-load-failed";
      document.body.dataset.runtimeErrorCount = "1";
      document.querySelector("#loader").hidden = true;
      document.querySelector("#error-copy").textContent = "The dedicated 742 viewer runtime could not be loaded. No substitute was shown.";
      failure.hidden = false;
      for (const selector of ["#app", ".interface", "#inspector", "#machine-controls-body"]) document.querySelector(selector)?.setAttribute("inert", "");
      document.querySelector(".control-panel")?.setAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
      document.querySelectorAll(".interface button, .interface input").forEach((control) => { control.disabled = true; });
      failure.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
      failure.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    };
